Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university with good academic record. Desirable: Working knowledge of computer and MS office. Hands-on-experience on seed/planting materials and/or agri-horticultural fields/laboratory.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 45 years Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Women as per ICAR/GOI guidelines.

content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Young Professional – I (YP-I) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: iari.res.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Young Professional – I (YP-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the ICAR IARI Young Professional – I (YP-I) recruitment is 25th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Young Professional – I (YP-I) post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional – I (YP-I) post is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional – I (YP-I) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month for the Young Professional – I (YP-I) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Young Professional – I (YP-I) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university with a good academic record.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ICAR IARI Young Professional – I (YP-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional – I (YP-I) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional – I (YP-I) role will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. When and where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted on 31st August 2026. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, and a link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
